messages:
ida: Quick random question — if you had to walk out the door right this second with only what you could realistically fit in your pockets, what 3 things would you grab?

sam: phone, wallet, earbuds. boring but true. :sweat_smile:

nina: keys, lip balm, a granola bar (hangry is a real mood).

omar: tiny multi-tool, metro card, lighter. (i got weirdly survivalist pockets)

felix: pocket notebook, pen, spare USB-C cable. tech + notes > everything.

zuri: hair tie, chapstick, dog treats (i always assume i'll run into a dog). :dog: :heart:

marco: passport, cash, lucky coin — mostly for dramatic exits.

ida: @zuri dog treats is the energy i respect. also @marco dramatic exits only with proper coinage.

sam: also realised i keep a tiny (torn) receipt with my partner's emergency contact in my wallet. practical but oddly sweet.

nina: rules update: if you can fold something into a pocket it counts. so i add a tiny pack of tissues.

omar: foldable face mask for me too. plus it doubles as an impromptu pothole-cleaning rag (don't ask).

felix: vote: pocket antiseptic wipes — underrated.

ida: tally so far: phone (3), wallet (2), chapstick/lip balm (2), keys, granola bar, lighter, multi-tool, notebook, pen, cable, dog treats, passport, cash, lucky coin, tissues, mask, wipes. interesting pockets. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

zuri: someone should make a 'pocket essentials' starter kit for new hires. low-cost onboarding perk. :thinking_face:
